limitations: Source/automated artifact reviews are agent engineering evidence, not external human or expert research approval.
Frontend validation mocks native transport and timers. Full frontend suite also includes inherited owned Node-reader subprocess fixtures.
Five-second frontend windows bound waiting/error presentation, not OS or IPC completion. The blocker and run ID map are in memory; page reload/remount recovery is not implemented or proven.
Owned containment cleanup confirms termination submission and known handles/readers. It is not an observation that all arbitrary or escaped descendants have exited.
Probe fixture 10-second fallback applies to gate/work/leaf loops; its blocking stdin read is not claimed to have a ten-second limit.
Local Cargo target and frontend dependencies are owned copies; neither is a clean installation. Local compilation uses a sidecar placeholder, and two packaged-sidecar tests are genuinely ignored.

Windows execution, three-platform final-head native packaging/real bridges, real desktop start/stop IPC and rendered native UI, screen-reader operation, shutdown, clean install/upgrade and signing require separate acceptance.
